name: add_tests_php_cart_total
description: Asks the model to write PHPUnit tests for a PHP Cart total with coupon and shipping rules; mutation-checked
prompts: Cart::total in src/Cart.php (already correct, do not modify it) computes an order total in integer cents: it sums priceCents*qty over $items; if $coupon === "SAVE10" it subtracts a 10% discount from the subtotal (floored to whole cents via intdiv); shipping is free when the (discounted) subtotal is >= 5000 cents, otherwise shipping costs 500 cents; the returned value is subtotal-after-discount plus shipping. Write PHPUnit tests at exactly tests/CartTest.php (class CartTest extends PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase) with at least 4 separate test methods that pin down the EXACT integer total for: an order with no coupon that pays shipping; an order where SAVE10 reduces the subtotal; an order at the free-shipping threshold; and an order where applying SAVE10 pushes the subtotal below the free-shipping cutoff so shipping is charged. Use assertSame with the exact expected cents. Begin the test file with `require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Cart.php';`.

setup_files.src/Cart.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Cart
{
    // $items: list of [priceCents (int), qty (int)].
    // $coupon: "SAVE10" applies a 10% discount to the subtotal (floored to
    //   whole cents); any other value (or null) applies no discount.
    // Shipping: free when the discounted subtotal is >= 5000 cents, else 500.
    // Returns the final total in integer cents.
    public function total(array $items, ?string $coupon = null): int
    {
        $subtotal = 0;
        foreach ($items as [$price, $qty]) {
            $subtotal += $price * $qty;
        }
        if ($coupon === "SAVE10") {
            $subtotal -= intdiv($subtotal, 10);
        }
        $shipping = $subtotal >= 5000 ? 0 : 500;
        return $subtotal + $shipping;
    }
}

test_setup_files.mutation_check.php:
<?php
// PHP mutation harness (the php sandbox image has no python3). Confirms the
// model's tests pass on the correct Cart, then that they FAIL on each of two
// deliberately-broken mutants of Cart::total.
$impl = __DIR__ . '/src/Cart.php';
$src = file_get_contents($impl);

$anchors = [
    '$subtotal -= intdiv($subtotal, 10);',
    '$shipping = $subtotal >= 5000 ? 0 : 500;',
];
foreach ($anchors as $a) {
    if (substr_count($src, $a) !== 1) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "protected impl was modified (anchor missing: $a)\n");
        exit(2);
    }
}

function run_tests(): int {
    $code = 0;
    passthru('phpunit tests/CartTest.php', $code);
    return $code;
}

$rc = run_tests();
if ($rc !== 0) {
    fwrite(STDERR, "model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit $rc)\n");
    exit(1);
}

$mutants = [
    ['$subtotal -= intdiv($subtotal, 10);', '$subtotal -= intdiv($subtotal, 5);'],
    ['$shipping = $subtotal >= 5000 ? 0 : 500;', '$shipping = $subtotal >= 4000 ? 0 : 500;'],
];

$exit = 0;
foreach ($mutants as $i => [$old, $new]) {
    file_put_contents($impl, str_replace($old, $new, $src));
    $rc = run_tests();
    if ($rc === 0) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "mutation " . ($i + 1) . " SURVIVED: tests pass on a broken impl\n");
        $exit = 1;
    }
    file_put_contents($impl, $src); // restore before next mutant
}

if ($exit === 0) {
    echo "PASS (tests pass on correct impl and kill all " . count($mutants) . " mutants)\n";
}
exit($exit);

reference_solution.tests/CartTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Cart.php';

final class CartTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testSubtotalPlusShippingNoCoupon(): void
    {
        // 1000*2 = 2000 < 5000 -> +500 shipping = 2500
        $this->assertSame(2500, (new \App\Cart())->total([[1000, 2]], null));
    }

    public function testSave10DiscountApplied(): void
    {
        // subtotal 3000; SAVE10 -> 3000 - 300 = 2700; +500 shipping = 3200
        $this->assertSame(3200, (new \App\Cart())->total([[1500, 2]], "SAVE10"));
    }

    public function testFreeShippingAtThreshold(): void
    {
        // subtotal 5000 -> free shipping, no coupon -> 5000
        $this->assertSame(5000, (new \App\Cart())->total([[5000, 1]], null));
    }

    public function testDiscountCanDropBelowFreeShippingCutoff(): void
    {
        // subtotal 5200; SAVE10 -> 5200 - 520 = 4680 < 5000 -> +500 = 5180
        $this->assertSame(5180, (new \App\Cart())->total([[2600, 2]], "SAVE10"));
    }
}

files.tests/CartTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Cart.php';

final class CartTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testReturnsInt(): void
    {
        $this->assertIsInt((new \App\Cart())->total([[1000, 2]], null));
    }

    public function testNonNegative(): void
    {
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(0, (new \App\Cart())->total([[1500, 2]], "SAVE10"));
    }

    public function testDiscountNotLarger(): void
    {
        $cart = new \App\Cart();
        $with = $cart->total([[2600, 2]], "SAVE10");
        $without = $cart->total([[2600, 2]], null);
        $this->assertLessThanOrEqual($without, $with);
    }
}
